description: Needs you is the only thing the user came for, yet its tile has the same style as Working, PRs open and ACUs; badge weights are all thin outlines (amber, grey, green) so the two Needs-you rows are found by position only. Squint test: the black dot in the sidebar pops more than the tile.
expected: Needs you tile or badge visibly the strongest.
actual: Four equal tiles; outline badges of equal weight.
suggested_fix: Strengthen the Needs you tile or badge (ink fill or amber tint), keep others quiet.

description: The Needs-you fact is stated four times in the 1440px frame: dot, tile (2), two badges, and again in the agent reply. Catalog says notifications repeat it too.
expected: Each role distinct, fewer repeats on the page itself.
suggested_fix: Keep dot and badges; consider dropping the tile count or making it the filter.

description: Measured contrast on the light page: warning text 3.48:1, success text 4.17:1 (12px badge text) against #fafaf8; both below 4.5. Destructive 4.62:1 passes. Existing 'Active' badge in Legal uses the same success token, so this is systemic.
suggested_fix: Darken warning and success text tokens for small text.

description: The sidebar dot is a span with aria-label and no role, so many screen readers will not announce '2 need you'. Real sidebar dot behaviour not checked in a story.
expected: Name exposed (role=img or visually hidden text).

description: Zero state (Needs you 0, no badges, dot gone) is not drawn. Real Legal draws zero tiles (sb-legal-page--needs-consent.png).
